meta.name: Free Gemini API
meta.description: Terminal Dark developer-tool SaaS — thin Gemini REST proxy with plan-based request quotas.

color.palette_type: OLED dark terminal with blue accent and semantic status hues

primary.role: Accent / CTA / own-system markers / focus ring

secondary.role: Accent highlight on hover and syntax strings

neutral.usage: void → surface → line → faint → muted → ink-2 → ink

color.contrast_strategy: Near-black void with high-contrast ink; accent used sparingly (90/10 rule); mint/amber/rose reserved for status

typography.font_style_notes: Inter for prose and UI; JetBrains Mono for kickers, paths, terminals, rate values, nav links, and form metadata. Never emoji as icons.

spacing.content_density: Comfortable marketing sections; denser for dashboard/admin tables
spacing.section_rhythm: Large vertical gaps (--s7–s9) between landing sections; forms use --s4–s5

layout.grid_system: Single-column content with optional 2-col hero; left gutter timeline (88px) on desktop
layout.alignment_tendency: Left-aligned content; brand lockup left; CTAs inline

shape.divider_style: Hairline --line-soft horizontal rules between endpoints and quota rows

elevation.strategy: Flat surfaces with border; deep shadow only on terminal chrome

motion.scroll_behavior: GSAP ScrollTrigger for waterfall bars and axis fill; CSS for hover micro-interactions
motion.reduced_motion: Disable scroll animations; keep instant state

components.button_primary: Filled --accent on dark text (#04101f), 6px radius, slight lift on hover
components.input: void background, --line border, focus --accent border; visible labels above fields
components.card: surface + 1px line + r-md/r-lg — use only for interactive containers (pricing CTA, forms)
components.nav: Sticky blurred void header; mono 12.5px links

design_style.personality: Senior engineer explaining a thin proxy; limits before promises
design_style.visual_language: Trace/timeline metaphor, monospace metadata, syntax-colored terminal demos
design_style.composition: One vertical narrative axis; hero = brand + one claim + terminal demo + CTA
design_style.imagery: No stock photos; product itself (curl, waterfall, endpoints) is the visual
design_style.interaction_feel: Snappy, instrumented, feedback-first (loading → success/error near field)
design_style.brand_voice: Specific, bilingual EN/PT, anti-superlative; cURL is the argument
design_style.ornamentation: Minimal — accent radial glow only in brand guide; landing stays flat void
design_style.whitespace_philosophy: Generous section breathing; dense data rows inside panels

overview.composite_notes: GSAP drives proportional bar draws and timeline fill; no WebGL/particles

scroll_effects.notes: TraceMotion axis fill + waterfall bar scrub via ScrollTrigger

css_special.notes: pending bar hatch animation; semantic verb chips; language data-l toggle
